"마비노기 모바일 제작재료 계산기" }, ]}, ]; const rootEl = document.getElementById('root'); const landingShell = document.getElementById('landing-shell'); const tabsEl = document.getElementById('tabs'); const rowsEl = document.getElementById('rows'); const yearEl = document.getElementById('year'); const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput'); yearEl.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear()); /* ===== 플랫폼 판별(pc / mo) ===== 우선순위: URL 강제 > 입력장치특성 > 폭 */ const urlPlatform = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get("platform"); const isCoarse = matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches; const CURRENT_PLATFORM = (urlPlatform === "pc" || urlPlatform === "mo") ? urlPlatform : (isCoarse || window.innerWidth <= 900 ? "mo" : "pc"); function supportsPlatform(p = "both") { if (!p || p === "both") return true; return p === CURRENT_PLATFORM; } function getPlatformGroups() { return menuData .filter(g => supportsPlatform(g.platforms)) .map(g => ({ ...g, children: (g.children || []).filter(it => supportsPlatform(it.platforms)) })) .filter(g => (g.children || []).length > 0); } let activeTab = 0; const guidePath = (p) => p.endsWith('/') ? p + 'guide/' : p + '/guide/'; function renderTabs(){ const platformGroups = getPlatformGroups(); if (activeTab >= platformGroups.length) activeTab = Math.max(platformGroups.length - 1, 0); tabsEl.innerHTML = ''; platformGroups.forEach((g, idx) => { const el = document.createElement('span'); el.className = 'tab' + (idx === activeTab ? ' active' : ''); el.textContent = g.label; el.tabIndex = 0; el.addEventListener('click', () => { activeTab = idx; renderRows(); highlightTab(); }); el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); activeTab = idx; renderRows(); highlightTab(); } }); tabsEl.appendChild(el); }); function highlightTab(){ [...tabsEl.children].forEach((c,i)=> c.className = 'tab' + (i===activeTab?' active':'')); } highlightTab(); if (platformGroups.length === 0) { rowsEl.innerHTML = '

이 기기에서 지원되는 메뉴가 없습니다.

'; } } function matchQuery(item, q){ return (item.label + ' ' + (item.path || '') + ' ' + (item.desc || '')) .toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()); } function renderRows(){ const platformGroups = getPlatformGroups(); if (platformGroups.length === 0) return; const q = searchInput.value.trim(); rowsEl.innerHTML = ''; const items = q ? platformGroups.flatMap(g => g.children).filter(it => matchQuery(it, q)) : (platformGroups[activeTab]?.children || []); if(items.length === 0){ const p = document.createElement('p'); p.textContent = q ? '검색 결과가 없습니다.' : '메뉴가 없습니다.'; p.style.opacity = .7; rowsEl.appendChild(p); return; } items.forEach((it) => { const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'row'; // 상단: 아이콘 + 제목 + 버튼 const head = document.createElement('div'); head.className = 'row-head'; const headLink = document.createElement('a'); headLink.className = 'row-head-link'; headLink.href = it.path; headLink.setAttribute('data-run', it.path); headLink.setAttribute('aria-label', it.label + ' 실행'); const icon = document.createElement('span'); icon.className = 'row-icon'; icon.innerHTML = `${it.icon || 'widgets'}`; const title = document.createElement('span'); title.className = 'row-title'; title.textContent = it.label; const acts = document.createElement('span'); acts.className = 'row-acts'; const guide = document.createElement('a'); guide.className = 'link'; guide.textContent = '가이드'; guide.href = guidePath(it.path); const exec = document.createElement('a'); exec.className = 'link primary'; exec.textContent = '실행'; exec.href = it.path; exec.setAttribute('data-run', it.path); acts.appendChild(guide); acts.appendChild(exec); head.appendChild(headLink); headLink.appendChild(icon); headLink.appendChild(title); head.appendChild(acts); const desc = document.createElement('div'); desc.className = 'row-desc'; desc.textContent = it.desc || ''; row.appendChild(head); if (it.desc) row.appendChild(desc); rowsEl.appendChild(row); }); attachRunHandlers(rowsEl); } function attachRunHandlers(scope=document){ scope.querySelectorAll('[data-run]').forEach((el) => { el.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const path = el.getAttribute('data-run') || '/'; runSpa(path); }); }); } function renderAll(){ renderTabs(); renderRows(); } renderAll(); searchInput.addEventListener('input', renderRows); // 창 크기 변경 시(모바일↔PC 전환) 재계산 let _resizeTimer; window.addEventListener('resize', () => { clearTimeout(_resizeTimer); _resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => { renderAll(); }, 150); }); // ===== SPA 전환기 ===== async function runSpa(routePath = location.pathname) { if (landingShell) landingShell.style.display = 'none'; rootEl.style.display = 'block'; if (!window.__SPA_BOOTSTRAPPED__) { window.__SPA_BOOTSTRAPPED__ = true; await import('/src/main.tsx'); } if (routePath && routePath !== location.pathname) { history.replaceState({}, '', routePath); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); } } // 비루트 직진입 → SPA만 표시 const isRoot = location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/index.html'; if (!isRoot) runSpa(location.pathname); // “메뉴 열기” document.getElementById('openAppBtn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); runSpa('/'); });
